newsitem.title: MEXICO: Serfin prepares commercial paper issue.
newsitem.headline: Serfin prepares commercial paper issue.

text.p: Banca Serfin, the third largest bank in Mexico and a unit of Grupo Financiero Serfin, is preparing to place a commercial paper issue worth about $230 million this week, said a bank director.
"We are close to placing an issue of commercial paper...and it will be about $230 million," said Eduardo Garcia Lecuona, director of international banking at Grupo Financiero Serfin.
The director said that the commercial paper will be issued on November 7. He declined to give details about the issue.
The funds will be used to support bank operations, he said, adding that they will not be used for capitalization of the bank.

That process of capitalization is 65 percent completed, he said. Serfin has capitalized $1.19 billion from the placement of new shares, the sale of assets and after a foreign company took a 20 percent stake.
